title: Facing Anxiety (Jonathan Pokluda)
description: A frank, practical look at what anxiety is and how trusting God reshapes the way we handle worry.
description_zh: 坦誠實用地探討焦慮是甚麼，以及信靠神如何改變我們面對憂慮的方式。

title: Countering Anxiety (Sidhara Udalagama)
description: Short sessions offering biblical perspective and simple practices for people wrestling with anxious thoughts.
description_zh: 簡短的課節，為受焦慮困擾的人提供聖經角度和簡單可行的操練。

title: Anxious for Nothing (Max Lucado)
description: Walks through Philippians 4 to show how prayer, gratitude and God's nearness can calm a worried heart.
description_zh: 透過腓立比書第四章，說明禱告、感恩和神的同在如何安定憂慮的心。

title: Mental Health Toolkit: Grief and Loss
title_zh: 心理健康工具箱：哀傷與失落
description: A single focused session helping people understand grief and find healthy, faith-filled ways to mourn.
description_zh: 一節重點課程，幫助人認識哀傷，並以健康、有信心的方式哀悼。

title: Mental Health Toolkit: Loneliness
description: A brief session naming the reality of loneliness and pointing to God and community as places of connection.
description_zh: 一節簡短課程，正視孤單的實況，並指向神和群體作為連結之處。

title: Equipping Care
description: Chaplains share practical wisdom for caring well for people facing illness, crisis and loss.
description_zh: 院牧分享實用智慧，教導如何好好關顧面對疾病、危機和失落的人。

title: The Essentials of Care
description: Explores lament, waiting and healing for those who suffer, and how to walk alongside the sick and their caregivers.
description_zh: 為受苦的人探討哀歌、等候與醫治，並學習如何陪伴病患及照顧者。

title: The Peaceful Caregiver (Mary Tutterow)
description: A long-time family caregiver shares how to receive and practise God's peace amid the strain of caring for loved ones.
description_zh: 一位資深家庭照顧者分享如何在照顧至親的壓力中領受並實踐神的平安。

title: The Art of Marriage
description: A rich couples' series on God's design for marriage, covering communication, conflict, intimacy and commitment.
description_zh: 一套內容豐富的夫婦課程，探討神對婚姻的設計，涵蓋溝通、衝突、親密和委身。

title: Love Talk (Les & Leslie Parrott)
description: Helps couples understand their communication styles and learn to talk and listen in more loving ways.
description_zh: 幫助夫婦了解彼此的溝通風格，學習以更有愛的方式說話和聆聽。

title: No More Perfect Marriages (Mark & Jill Savage)
title_zh: 不再追求完美婚姻（Mark & Jill Savage）
description: Encourages couples to let go of unrealistic expectations and build a grace-shaped marriage.
description_zh: 鼓勵夫婦放下不切實際的期望，建立以恩典為本的婚姻。

title: Grace Filled Marriage (Tim Kimmel)
description: Shows how God's grace can transform the daily habits and hard moments of married life.
description_zh: 說明神的恩典如何改變婚姻生活中的日常習慣和艱難時刻。

title: Marriage as God Intended (Kip' Chelashaw)
description: A short study on the biblical foundations of marriage and what they mean for couples today.
description_zh: 簡短研習婚姻的聖經根基，以及它對今日夫婦的意義。

title: The Art of Parenting
description: Equips parents to raise children with a clear vision of faith, character and identity in Christ.
description_zh: 裝備父母以清晰的信仰、品格及在基督裏的身份異象養育兒女。

title: Intentional Motherhood (Renelle Roberts)
description: Encourages mothers to parent with purpose, grace and dependence on God in everyday family life.
description_zh: 鼓勵母親在日常家庭生活中帶着目標、恩典並倚靠神去養育兒女。

title: Navigating Your Finances God's Way
description: Practical biblical teaching on budgeting, debt, saving and giving from a stewardship perspective.
description_zh: 從管家角度，就預算、債務、儲蓄和奉獻提供實用的聖經教導。

title: The Generosity Practice (John Mark Comer)
description: Explores giving as a spiritual practice that frees us from greed and joins God's care for the poor.
description_zh: 探討奉獻作為一種屬靈操練，叫我們脫離貪婪，並參與神對貧窮人的關懷。

title: Prayer (Michael DeFazio)
description: A thorough teaching series on how Scripture shapes our understanding and practice of prayer.
description_zh: 一套深入的教導課程，探討聖經如何塑造我們對禱告的理解和實踐。

title: The Prayer Course II: Unanswered Prayer (Pete Greig)
title_zh: 禱告課程 II：未蒙應允的禱告（Pete Greig）
description: Honestly faces the pain of unanswered prayer and how to keep trusting God through disappointment and doubt.
description_zh: 誠實面對禱告未蒙應允的痛苦，以及如何在失望和疑惑中繼續信靠神。

title: Faith, Work, Calling and Vocation
description: Explores how everyday work fits into God's purposes and how to live out faith in the workplace.
description_zh: 探討日常工作如何融入神的旨意，以及如何在職場活出信仰。

title: Monday Matters (Mark Bilton)
description: Encourages believers to see their Monday-to-Friday work as meaningful ministry and witness.
description_zh: 鼓勵信徒把週一至週五的工作看為有意義的事奉和見證。

title: Your Second Act (Kitti Murray)
description: A story-driven series for anyone facing a career change, showing how purpose and mission can guide a new season.
description_zh: 以故事帶動的課程，適合面對轉職的人，說明使命和目標如何引導人生新階段。

title: Identity in Christ (Faith Driven Entrepreneur)
title_zh: 在基督裏的身份（Faith Driven Entrepreneur）
description: Business leaders reflect on finding identity in Christ rather than in achievement or success.
description_zh: 商界領袖反思如何在基督裏而非在成就中尋找身份。

title: Identity (Eric Mason)
description: A youth-focused study on who God says we are and how that truth shapes everyday choices.
description_zh: 以青少年為對象，研習神如何定義我們，以及這真理如何影響日常抉擇。

title: The Best of Friends (Phil Knox)
description: Explores the gift of friendship and how to build deep, Christ-centred friendships in a lonely age.
description_zh: 探討友誼的恩賜，以及如何在孤單的時代建立以基督為中心的深厚友誼。

title: Friends (Sean McDowell)
description: A youth series on choosing good friends and being a faithful friend.
description_zh: 一套青少年課程，探討如何選擇好朋友以及做一個忠心的朋友。

title: Conflict (Doug Fields)
description: Students share real stories of conflict with family, friends, authority and God, with biblical steps toward peace.
description_zh: 學生分享與家人、朋友、權威及神之間衝突的真實故事，並提供邁向和好的聖經步驟。

title: Holy Habits (Derwin Gray)
description: Shows how Spirit-empowered habits such as peacemaking and forgiveness shape us into Christ's likeness.
description_zh: 說明聖靈加力的習慣，例如促進和睦與饒恕，如何塑造我們更像基督。

title: Path to Forgiveness (Mark Goodman)
description: A step-by-step look at what biblical forgiveness is and how to begin forgiving those who hurt us.
description_zh: 逐步探討聖經中的饒恕是甚麼，以及如何開始饒恕傷害我們的人。

title: The Forgiveness Dilemma (Beth Koep)
description: Short sessions that wrestle honestly with why forgiveness is hard and how God makes it possible.
description_zh: 簡短課節，誠實探討為何饒恕困難，以及神如何使之成為可能。

title: The Ruthless Elimination of Hurry (John Mark Comer)
title_zh: 無情地除掉匆忙（John Mark Comer）
description: Invites busy people to slow down and embrace Sabbath, solitude and simplicity with Jesus.
description_zh: 邀請忙碌的人放慢腳步，與耶穌一同擁抱安息、獨處和簡樸。

title: Hope: Exploring God's Plan (Karen Sawrey)
title_zh: 盼望：探索神的計劃（Karen Sawrey）
description: Traces God's plan through Scripture to show where lasting hope is found.
description_zh: 追溯聖經中神的計劃，指出持久的盼望在哪裏。

title: Exploring Evangelism (Simon Gill)
description: Very short, accessible videos that help ordinary believers start natural conversations about Jesus.
description_zh: 非常簡短易明的影片，幫助一般信徒自然地開始談論耶穌。

title: Crash Course on Evangelism (Bobby Conway)
description: A practical primer on sharing the gospel clearly and answering common questions.
description_zh: 實用入門課程，教導如何清楚傳講福音及回應常見問題。

title: Race and the Gospel (Bryan Loritts & Matt Chandler)
title_zh: 種族與福音（Bryan Loritts & Matt Chandler）
description: Looks at how the gospel breaks down dividing walls and calls the church to reconciliation.
description_zh: 探討福音如何拆毀隔斷的牆，並呼召教會追求和好。

title: Arise (IF:Gathering with IJM)
description: Daily short videos exploring God's heart for justice and how believers can respond to oppression.
description_zh: 每日短片，探討神對公義的心意，以及信徒如何回應壓迫。

title: Doctrine (Francis Chan)
description: A youth-friendly overview of core Christian beliefs about God, Scripture, salvation and the church.
description_zh: 以青少年易明的方式概覽基督教的核心信仰：神、聖經、救恩和教會。

title: Heart of God (Francis Chan)
description: Short reflections for young people on God's character and his love for them.
description_zh: 為年輕人預備的簡短反思，談神的屬性及祂對他們的愛。

title: Apologetics (Matt Chandler)
description: Engages honest questions about faith and gives reasons for trusting the Christian message.
description_zh: 回應有關信仰的真誠疑問，並提出相信基督信息的理由。

title: How to Read the Bible (Michael DeFazio)
description: Teaches practical principles such as reading in context and paying attention to genre so we hear God through Scripture.
description_zh: 教導實用原則，例如按上下文閱讀和留意文體，好讓我們透過聖經聆聽神。

title: How to Read Your Bible (Jennie Allen, Bianca Juárez Olthoff & Jo Saxton)
title_zh: 如何讀你的聖經（Jennie Allen 等）
description: A beginner-friendly study showing how the Old and New Testaments connect and how to dig into a passage.
description_zh: 適合初信者的研習，展示新舊約如何連貫，以及如何深入研讀經文。

title: The Book of Ruth (Bianca Juárez)
description: Walks through Ruth to show God's quiet faithfulness to people facing loss, famine and uncertainty.
description_zh: 逐段講解路得記，展現神對面對失落、饑荒和不確定的人默默的信實。

title: The Book of Jonah (David Platt)
description: Explores Jonah's reluctant mission and what it reveals about God's mercy for all peoples.
description_zh: 探討約拿不情願的使命，以及這揭示神對萬民的憐憫。

title: Psalms: A Voice for All Seasons (Tasha Calvert)
title_zh: 詩篇：每個季節的心聲（Tasha Calvert）
description: Introduces the structure and themes of the Psalms and how they teach us to pray through every season of life.
description_zh: 介紹詩篇的結構和主題，以及詩篇如何教導我們在人生每個季節中禱告。

title: The Gospel of John: Part 1 (Tony Evans)
description: Studies the first half of John's Gospel, inviting viewers to believe in Jesus and find life in him.
description_zh: 研讀約翰福音前半部，邀請觀眾相信耶穌並在祂裏面得生命。

title: The Gospel of John: Part 2 (Tony Evans)
description: Covers Jesus' final days, death and resurrection in John and the hope they offer.
description_zh: 講述約翰福音中耶穌最後的日子、受死與復活，以及其中帶來的盼望。

title: Your Kingdom Come: Sermon on the Mount (Jim Dalrymple)
title_zh: 願你的國降臨：登山寶訓（Jim Dalrymple）
description: Unpacks Matthew 5-7 and what it looks like to live as citizens of God's kingdom.
description_zh: 闡釋馬太福音五至七章，以及作為神國子民的生活樣式。

title: Resilient (Sheridan Voysey)
description: Draws on the Sermon on the Mount to build a resilient life grounded in Jesus' teaching.
description_zh: 從登山寶訓出發，建立以耶穌教導為根基、有韌力的生命。

title: The Acts of the Apostles (Louie Giglio)
description: Follows the early church in Acts and God's mission that still invites us today.
description_zh: 跟隨使徒行傳中的初期教會，看見今日仍邀請我們參與的神的使命。

title: Book of James (Sebastian Lucido)
description: In-depth teaching on James about persevering in trials, taming the tongue and a faith that acts.
description_zh: 深入教導雅各書，談在試煉中堅忍、勒住舌頭和有行動的信心。

title: Unpacking Philippians (Darlene Zschech)
description: Explores a Christ-centred life of joy, contentment and peace through Paul's letter to the Philippians.
description_zh: 透過保羅寫給腓立比教會的書信，探討以基督為中心、滿有喜樂知足和平安的生命。
